claim: Sentiero del Barolo from La Morra is 11.5 km, 3h15 duration, starts at the Tourist Office in La Morra and descends toward Alba.
quote: The route starts at the Tourist Office in La Morra and descends in the direction of Alba... 11.5 km... 3 h 15 min

claim: Monforte d'Alba to Serralunga d'Alba walking path is ~3.5 km each way, 107 m elevation gain, difficulty E (easy), marked with CAI signs 303/308/304.
quote: Distance: 3.5 km each way... 107 m elevation gain... Difficulty Level: E (easy)... Numbers 303, 308, and 304 with classic red and white signs

claim: Sentiero Rosso loop Barolo–Monforte d'Alba–Barolo (trails #310/#301) is roughly 3.5 hours total hiking with 267 m elevation gain, difficulty E, starting at Piazza Cabutto in Barolo (213 m).
quote: Approximately 1 hour 45 minutes each direction (3.5 hours total)... Elevation Gain: 267 meters... Starting Point: Barolo village (213m)

claim: Sentiero del Barbaresco starts in Neive (308 m), ring route ~14 km marked red-white, difficulty E with ~150 m elevation gain, ~1h45 each way.
quote: starts in Neive at 308 m elevation... ring route is marked with red-white paint notches and is about 14 km long... difficulty level is E... elevation gain of about 150 m... 1h 45′ for the outward route

claim: BikeSquare e-bike rentals in the Langhe start at €35/day with a pickup base in Novello (Loc. Ciocchini 18) covering Barolo-area routes.
quote: E-bike rentals start at €35 per day in the Langhe region... Address: Loc. Ciocchini, 18 - 12060 Novello (CN)

claim: Rent Your Bike in Castiglione Falletto (Via Alba-Barolo 99) rents casual e-bikes and electric MTBs at €40/day (€30 half-day), open Tue–Sun 9:00–12:30 and 14:30–17:30.
quote: Casual E-bikes: €40/day... Electric MTB: €40/day... half-day rates (€30)... Castiglione Falletto (CN)... Via Alba-Barolo, 99... Tuesday-Sunday: 9:00am–12:30pm, 2:30pm–5:30pm

claim: Panchina Gigante #254 sits on Via Vittorio Emanuele in Castiglione Falletto with a panoramic view toward Serralunga d'Alba.
quote: Panchina Gigante #254... Via Vittorio Emanuele, Castiglione Falletto... fascinating views of the heights of Serralunga d'Alba

claim: La Morra hosts the red 'Panchina Gigante della Serenità', popularly bench #27 in the Langhe circuit (operates outside the official BBCP numbering).
quote: Panchina Gigante della Serenità - La Morra

claim: Alba in May averages 23 °C daytime high / 13 °C nighttime low, ~97 mm rain across ~14 rainy days and ~196 hours of sunshine.
quote: Daytime highs average 23°C (73°F) with nighttime lows of 13°C... About 14 days with rain, averaging 97 mm... approximately 196 hours of sun

claim: Alba in June averages 27 °C high / 16 °C low, ~78 mm rain across ~13 rainy days and ~221 sunshine hours, ranking it among the best months to visit.
quote: Daytime highs average 27°C (81°F)... nighttime lows dip to 16°C... 13 rainy days... 78 mm... 221 hours of sunshine

claim: May is often the wettest month of the year in Piedmont, with thunderstorms possible into early June.
quote: May in Piedmont is often the rainiest month of the year, especially in the western and northern parts
